_about: Accepted differences for tests/compare-step1.mjs (step 1). Boxes are in picture pixels (2x), [x0, y0, x1, y1]. A region passes only when it lies wholly inside a listed box and is not a shifted row. Anti-aliasing entries apply to pictures rendered on the old Mac and only where the built app equals the approved source re-rendered on this Mac.

antiAliasing.reason: Picture rendered on the old Mac; this Mac anti-aliases text, the logo and icons slightly differently. Inside the region the built app is identical to the approved source rendered on this Mac.
antiAliasing.evidence: Session 4 run (2026-11-09): the same approved source files rendered on this Mac vs their old-Mac pictures differ by at most 2,846 px over 8/255 per picture, strongest channel difference 103, no shifted row or moved box (offer pictures carry more icon edges than the D-92 pictures the main thread measured at ~1,700 px / 93). The built app equals the source rendered on this Mac in every accepted region (0 px over 8/255). Limits = measured maximum plus about 5%. New-Mac pictures (returning unlock, D-92) are exact. Heatmaps: docs/renders/2026-11-09-step1-recovery/compare/<state>_w<width>.png; numbers: compare/results.md.
